content.text:
To create a comprehensive codelist for **Eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE)**, I have searched the CPRD dictionary for relevant clinical terms, including both UK ("oesophagitis") and US ("esophagitis") spellings, as well as specific clinical manifestations like ulcers related to eosinophilic infiltration in the esophagus.

Here is the complete codelist containing the Read codes that indicate a diagnosis or presence of Eosinophilic Esophagitis:

| Original Read Code | Term |
| :--- | :--- |
| `J1017` | Eosinophilic oesophagitis |
| `^ESCTEO508265` | Eosinophilic esophagitis |
| `^ESCT1165474` | Food-induced eosinophilic oesophagitis |
| `^ESCTEO508286` | Eosinophilic ulcer of oesophagus |

*(Note: While eosinophilic ulcer of the oesophagus refers to a specific localized presentation, it inherently reflects active eosinophilic inflammation of the esophagus within the EoE spectrum and is included for diagnostic completeness).*
